title: Yorkshire Beef Pudding Bites Italian Style
description: A twist on the classic British dish, these bite-sized Yorkshire beef pudding treats are infused with Italian flavors.
instructions: In a bowl, combine ground beef, flour, eggs, milk, and a pinch of salt. Mix well.
Add 1 cup of Yorkshire flour and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces.
Shape each piece into a ball and then flatten slightly into a disk.
Place the disks on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
